adjudication.rationale: In app/models/embeddable_host.rb the `before_validation` callback unconditionally calls `self.host.sub!(...)` twice. If `host` is nil, this raises `NoMethodError` before Rails validations can run. The admin controller assigns `host.host = params[:embeddable_host][:host]` without guarding for missing params, so a POST/PUT with omitted host would hit this path and crash with a 500 instead of returning a validation error JSON response.
